verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's Query Builder lets users construct ad-hoc queries with SELECT/WHERE/GROUP BY/ORDER BY/HAVING clauses on any field (including user id, request id) without needing pre-defined indexes, and BubbleUp helps isolate outliers by any field value on the fly [honeycomb-docs-3, honeycomb-docs-16, honeycomb-docs-24, honeycomb-docs-32, honeycomb-docs-28]. Relational field prefixes (root., parent., child., anyX.) further show flexible querying across trace structure without pre-aggregation [honeycomb-docs-17, honeycomb-docs-25]. Missing for 10: explicit documentation stating 'no indexing or pre-aggregation required' and independent hands-on benchmarks confirming high-cardinality performance at scale.
